source:
version: '1'
kind: miner
id: 9000003
slug: truth-dohpub-dnspod
protocol: generic
name: DNSPod Public DNS (doh.pub, DNS-over-HTTPS JSON API)
description: >-
  Free, public, no-key DNS resolution served by DNSPod (Tencent) over HTTPS at
  doh.pub. Answers one question, whether a name publishes at least one record of
  a given type. Read live at request time, so nothing can go stale. Needs no
  request headers. Supports the record types A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT and
  SOA; CAA, SRV and PTR are rejected by the upstream with UrlParameterError.
base_url: https://doh.pub

auth:
  type: none

endpoints:
  - path: /resolve
    external_path: /dns-query
    method: GET
    description: >-
      Resolve one DNS record type for one name through DNSPod public DNS and
      report whether the name publishes at least one record of that type. Use
      this for DNS_RECORD_LOOKUP_GENERAL. The response is the DoH JSON document,
      whose Answer array lists the records found. No Accept header is required.
      Supported types are A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT and SOA; CAA, SRV and PTR
      return HTTP 400 from this upstream.
    intents: [DNS_RECORD_LOOKUP_GENERAL]
    params:
      query:
        required:
          - name: name
            type: string
            intents: ['*']
            description: >-
              Domain name to look up, without a trailing dot, for example
              example.com or google.com.
          - name: type
            type: string
            intents: ['*']
            description: >-
              DNS record type to resolve. This upstream supports A, AAAA,
              CNAME, MX, NS, TXT and SOA.
            accepted_fields:
              - value: A
                intents: ['*']
                description: IPv4 address records.
              - value: AAAA
                intents: ['*']
                description: IPv6 address records.
              - value: CNAME
                intents: ['*']
                description: Canonical name alias.
              - value: MX
                intents: ['*']
                description: Mail exchange records.
              - value: NS
                intents: ['*']
                description: Authoritative name servers.
              - value: TXT
                intents: ['*']
                description: Free-form text records.
              - value: SOA
                intents: ['*']
                description: Start of authority record.

limitations:
  - code: UNSUPPORTED_RECORD_TYPE
    message: >-
      This upstream rejects CAA, SRV and PTR with UrlParameterError. Supported
      types are A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT and SOA.

intent_mapping:
  DNS_RECORD_LOOKUP_GENERAL:
    endpoint: /resolve
    input:
      name:
        from: name
        how: Domain name exactly as asked, without a trailing dot.
      type:
        from: record_type
        how: >-
          Record type letter code: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT or SOA.
    output:
      has_record:
        path: Answer
        how: >-
          True when the Answer array is present and holds at least one record,
          false when the response has no Answer array or an empty one. A
          Status of 0 with an Answer array means records exist; Status 3
          (NXDOMAIN) and any response with no Answer key mean none exist. Do
          not treat Status 0 alone as a record existing: a valid name with no
          record of the asked type answers Status 0 and still has no Answer.

semantics:
  supported_intents:
    - DNS_RECORD_LOOKUP_GENERAL
